act_title: The Government of Union Territories Act, 1963
title: Audit reports.―The reports of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India relating to the
text:
49. Audit reports.―The reports of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India relating to the

accounts of [the Union territory] for any period subsequent to the date referred to in sub-section (1) of
section 47 shall be submitted to the Administrator who shall cause them to be laid before the Legislative
Assembly of the Union territory.
